comment: No source is published. The colour jack, input 3, is dead: nothing in the module reads it. The delay rate is half the clock rate times two raised to 9.9658 minus 13.2876 times the time knob plus the time jack, so a volt at the time jack doubles or halves the delay and the knob spans 1ms to 10 seconds; the configured display base of 10000 and multiplier of 0.001 agree, and the default of 0.6747 gives exactly half a second at the 2Hz base rate. The clock input is measured edge to edge and only accepted between 0.001Hz and 1000Hz. The filter in the feedback path is a one-pole lowpass whose corner is 100 raised to twice the colour knob minus one, times 20000, clamped to 39Hz and 11000Hz. Reverse is a latch: the button toggles on each press and the jack exclusive-ors with it.
